text: I need a walker for use at home after my upcoming appointment. Can someone help me get one ordered?

Need a walker at home. Who arranges this?

I need help to get walker for my home. Please who can help me order this.
hi so i think i need a walker for around the house can somebody here help me get that set up

so i am going to need a shower chair and the raised toilet seat thing who at the office helps with ordering stuff like that

Home health visits needed. Please start the paperwork.
